data_policy_type.description: Type of data policy. Possible values: `DATA_MASKING_POLICY`, `RAW_DATA_ACCESS_POLICY`, `COLUMN_LEVEL_SECURITY_POLICY`.
data_policy_type.rationale: RAW_DATA_ACCESS_POLICY gives direct access to the data.

data_policy_id.description: User-assigned ID of the data policy that must be unique within the project.

location.description: Resource location for the data policy.
location.rationale: Location can be restricted to approved regions.
location.compliant: Set `location` to an approved AU region such as `australia-southeast1`.
location.non-compliant: Set `location` to an unapproved region such as `europe-west1`.

data_masking_policy.description: The policy block used to specify a masking rule.
data_masking_policy.rationale: Masking rules affect how data is shown.
data_masking_policy.compliant: Set `data_masking_policy` with an approved predefined expression or approved routine.
data_masking_policy.non-compliant: Use a weak masking expression or an unapproved routine.

predefined_expression.description: A predefined masking expression. Possible values include `SHA256`, `ALWAYS_NULL`, `DEFAULT_MASKING_VALUE`, `LAST_FOUR_CHARACTERS`, `FIRST_FOUR_CHARACTERS`, `EMAIL_MASK`, `DATE_YEAR_MASK`, `RANDOM_HASH`.
predefined_expression.rationale: The masking expression controls how much data is revealed.
predefined_expression.non-compliant: Set `predefined_expression` to a partial reveal value such as `FIRST_FOUR_CHARACTERS`.

routine.description: Custom masking routine in the format `projects/{project_number}/datasets/{dataset_id}/routines/{routine_id}`.
routine.rationale: Custom routine can change masking behavior.
routine.compliant: Set `routine` to an approved masking routine reference.
routine.non-compliant: Set `routine` to an unapproved masking routine reference.

grantees.description: IAM principals with fine-grained access to the underlying data.
grantees.rationale: grantees controls who can access the data.
grantees.non-compliant: Leave `grantees` empty, include `principalSet://goog/public:all`, include `principalSet://goog/cloudIdentityCustomerId/...`, or include direct user principals.

project.description: Project ID for the resource. If omitted, the provider project is used.
